items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: That's a picture from Chicago. About the same time I have one taken with Big Eye. When they were both with the three old band.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know exactly when that was taken. It looks quite young, though. But I tell you, that's an old picture. Mm-hmm. Yeah, that's an old picture. When was that one of you taken, Louis? Well, I was taken that in, I got it in the book. About how old would you be then? Oh, I was 25 years old. 25 years old. I was 1914 then, and so. I was 25. And how old would Freddie be? Well, Freddie would be 24. 24. Yeah. At that time when he was taken on that photograph? Well, no, not when he was taken on that photograph.…

What are you taking? Looks like that might be one of those taken in Chicago once. Yeah, it was. That's a picture from Chicago. About the same time I have one taken with Big Eye. When they were both with the three old band. That looks like about almost the same set, the way. Yeah, it's the same thing. The way he's dressed, and I don't know. He can't tell. Nah.

I have one here. Yeah, I did. I have that other one over. I believe I have that other one over here. Is that working over there? Nah, this one here. Now, that's the one you might have been taking. Now, this here. This photograph taken. Over there, I have students. Freddie Kepler, 253, 255. Tremont Street. Boston. Boston. Boston, Mississippi. No, Massachusetts. That was taken in Boston. Oh, yeah. That's when he has a white uniform on.
